.set(\"User-Agent\", &format!(\"needle/{CURRENT_VERSION}\"))\n434\t            .call()\n435\t        {\n436\t            Ok(r) if r.status() < 400 => r,\n437\t            Ok(r) => {\n438\t      // A canary test dispatches a real agent against a real bead, which\n573\t        // routinely takes longer than five minutes — so the hardcoded budget\n574\t        // failed every test by ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n666\t\n667\t/// Compute the SHA-256 hash of a file, returned as a hex string.\n668\tpub fn file_hash(path: &Path) -> binary.\n678\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\n679\tpub enum HotReloadCheck {\n680\t    /// No change detected — current binary matches :stable.\n681\t    NoChange,\n682\t    /// New :stable found.\n700\t    Skipped { reason: String },\n701\t}\n702\t\n703\t/// Check whether the `:stable` binary differs from the currently running binary.\n704\t///\n705\t/// This is called between LOGGING and SELECTING in the worker loop.\n706\tpub fn check_hot_reload(needle_home: &Path) -> Result<HotReloadCheck> {\n707\t    let stable_path = needle_home.join(\"bin/needle-stable\");\n708\t\n709\t    if !stable_path.exists() {\n710\t        return Ok(HotReloadCheck::Skipped {\n711\t            reason: \"no :stable binary found\".to_string(),\n712\t        });\n713\t    }\n714\t\n715\t    let the current process.\n755\t/// On failure, it returns an error so the worker can continue on the current binary.\n756\t#[cfg(unix)]\n757\tpub async fn re_exec_stable(\n758\t    stable_path: &Path,\n759\t    worker_name: &str,\n760\t    workspace: Option<&Path>,\n761\t    agent: Option<&str>,\n762\t    timeout: Option<u64>,\n763\t) -> Result<()> {\n764\t    let stable_path = a.to_string());\n768\t\n769\t    // Retry with ETXTBSY handling - the :stable binary was just written and may be busy\n770\t    let mut child = spawn_with_etxtbsy_retry_child(\n771\t        || {\n772\t            let stable_path = stable_path.clone();\n773\t            let worker_name = worker_name.clone();\n774\t            let workspace = workspace.clone();\n775\t            let agent =      cmd.arg(\"--identifier\").arg(&worker_name);\n780\t                cmd.arg(\"--count\").arg(\"1\");\n781\t\n782\t                if let Some(ws) = &workspace {\n783\t                    cmd.arg(\"--workspace\").arg(ws);\n784\t                }\n785\t                if let Some(a) = &agent {\n786\t                    cmd.arg(\"--agent\").arg(a);\n787\t                }\n788\t },\n795\t        5,  // max_attempts\n796\t        20, // backoff_ms\n797\t    )\n798\t    .await\n799\t    .context(\"failed to spawn :stable binary after retries\")?;\n800\t\n801\t    // Wait for          EventKind::WorkerBooting {\n                worker_name,\n                version,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"worker_name\": worker_name, \"version\": version })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerStarted {\n                worker_name,\n                version,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"worker_name\": worker_name, \"version\": version })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerStopped {\n                reason,\n                beads_processed,\n                uptime_secs,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"reason\": reason,\n                    \"beads_processed\": beads_processed,\n                    \"uptime_secs\": uptime_secs,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerErrored {\n                error_type,\n                error_message,\n                beads_processed,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"error_type\": error_type,\n                    \"error_message\": error_message,\n                    \"beads_processed\": beads_processed,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerExhausted {\n                cycle_count,\n                last_strand,\n                waterfall_restarts,\n                restart_triggers,\n                strand_evaluations,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"cycle_count\": cycle_count,\n                    \"last_strand_evaluated\": last_strand,\n                    \"waterfall_restarts\": waterfall_restarts,\n                    \"restart_triggers\": restart_triggers,\n                    \"strand_evaluations\": strand_evaluations,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerIdle { backoff_seconds } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"backoff_seconds\": backoff_seconds })\n            }\n            EventKind::StateTransition { from, to } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"from\": format!(\"{from}\"), \"to\": format!(\"{to}\") })\n            }\n            EventKind::InitStepStarted { step } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"step\": step })\n            }\n            EventKind::InitStepCompleted { step, duration_ms } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"step\": step, \"duration_ms\": duration_ms })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerBootTimeout { elapsed_ms } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"elapsed_ms\": elapsed_ms })\n            }\n
